meta.note: Summaries and keywords were written from the titles in the group's Scopus record; edit freely. Each 'id' is referenced from publications.json.

areas.title: Intelligent Control
areas.summary: Fuzzy, neural, and learning-based controllers, with optimization and reinforcement learning used to tune them, and formal guarantees on stability and performance.

areas.title: Cyber Physical Systems
areas.summary: Control of physical systems that depend on computation and communication, with fault detection, fault-tolerant control, and resilience to cyber attacks, in vehicles, robots, and power systems.

areas.title: Networked Systems
areas.summary: Event-triggered and distributed control and estimation for networked and multi-agent systems, under time delays, limited communication, and denial-of-service attacks.
